name: Chasing A-Me 01
label: Quest
description: Chasing A-Me 01: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Checking to see if your prepared to lead A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel, you flip the switch to the "Off" position. Glancing around once again to make sure none of the gorillas are coming, you prepare to see what happens when you flip the switch back to the "On" position.
This is your last chance... Are you sure this is what you want to do?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been able to help A-Me? That mithril casing you mentioned being destroyed was a good guess at what was wrong. I'm sure if you replace that, she'll reactivate and be able to come home.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, you've done it! Wonderful! Thank you, friend.
Oh, my poor, A-Me. Look at all those dents. We'll get her up and running perfectly with just a little work.
Thank you again, friend. I really appreciate it.
